source.citation: Dugger et al. 2026, Frontiers in Ecology and Evolution 14:1868960

published_scale.typical_prospecting_context: Published discussion reports prospecting below 3% except Royds pre-breeders ages 5-7 prospecting at Bird, where estimates peak at 8-12%.
published_scale.moving_recruitment: Published recruitment into a different colony is <0.10%, emphasizing that prospecting and final settlement movement are distinct processes.

model_based_scale_context.warning: These are not observed eligible event counts. They apply model-derived hypothetical-cohort recruitment fractions to reported banding totals solely to assess order of magnitude before outcome access.

constraints_that_reduce_real_eligibility: Primary choice events require PB observations in the two seasons preceding first breeding.
Candidate set must contain at least two actually visited Ross colonies and include the first breeding colony.
Prior-year three-colony performance must pass the >=20 interpretable breeder threshold.
Prior-year colony size must be complete for every candidate.
BIRD-containing candidate sets are excluded for first-breeding seasons 2014 onward.
MAPPPD size-control missing years and other frozen censoring rules can remove additional events.

decision.reason: Published sample scale makes the two-stage gate plausible but provides no reliable count of events satisfying the much narrower observed-prospecting candidate-set rule.
decision.if_source_gate_fails: STOP without fitting the choice model.
decision.if_source_gate_passes_but_choice_gate_fa: STOP without fitting the choice model.

claim_boundary: Do not present the rough 4,846 scale as an observed number of recruits.
Do not infer prospective power or a probability of passing the gate from published transition-rate point estimates alone.
Do not relax the two-season lookback, candidate-set definition, or 100/50 thresholds after real data are opened.
